visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of feature cards (icon or image, heading, short text, optional CTA) used for benefits, ways to help, payment options, download tiles, steps and expandable FAQ tiles

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; each row has an optional icon/image cell + body cell (heading, text, lists, CTA links). An optional first single-cell row with a heading becomes the block intro; with `icon-left-photo-background` an optional first picture-only row becomes the background. A body cell holding only a link to a /fragments/ path is replaced by that fragment; a cell holding only a YouTube/Vimeo/MP4 link becomes an embedded video

usage: Feature/benefit grids across content pages: 'Ways we can help', product options, payment methods, claim channels, disaster checklists, numbered process steps and partner FAQ tiles.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-5 equal cards with an icon or small image and short copy. Use `boxed`/`shadow`/`grey*`/`cyan*` for bordered or filled card shells, `icon-left*` to put the icon beside the title, `link-tiles`/`shadow-image`/`grey-image`/`icon-left-download` when each card is a single link, `steps` for numbered steps, and `partner` for collapsible question tiles. Large media/text splits belong in columns-media.
